title: Bewegtbild
slide_intent: Make changing scenes and speaker information easy to follow because recurring audiovisual elements provide orientation.
strategic_value: Consistent logo endings, transitions and lower thirds can identify DB while keeping a film understandable.
demonstration: The section presents logo treatment, endings, business-unit lockup specimens, separators, lower thirds and the default Title and Action Safe diagram. Video placeholders mark the preserved webpage state; clips are separately playable.
practical_value: Choose a transition or lower third by content complexity, and place essential information within the specified title-safe area.
